text:
Sam T: quick sync - prototyping a tiny admit/commit/abort flow for dedicated pools. goal: low-latency decisions + safe accounting.
Lin Q: minimal API?
Sam T: admit(request_id, tenant, tokens, warmup_hint) -> provisional_id|deny; commit(provisional_id); abort(provisional_id); headroom(tenant, region) + watch.
Javier M: provisional TTL 15-45s. server dedupe by request_id so retries return same result.
Priya K: warmup_hint should include penalty_tokens so runtime can choose fallback vs queue. fallback options: cheaper model, enqueue ETA, shortened response.
Lin Q: headroom must include provisioning_ms to decide cross-region moves.
Sam T: revoke flow: soft-reserve can revoke provisional before commit; runtime must fallback on revoke event.
Javier M: observability: emit admit/commit/abort events with trace id. test: simulate 10k concurrent admits assert active_provisionals <= committed+burst.
Priya K: admin endpoints: list_provisionals, force_release, simulate_headroom. billing: bill on commit, show pending on provisional.
scale-bot: created INF-912 provisional-admit-metrics.
Sam T: action: Lin proto, Javier store PoC, Priya tests. reconvene after alpha metrics.
